label: PF Backlog 576
title: Per-worker sync (BI-PF-1176 step 3): auto-resolve generated docs + counters on merge, and a sync_develop helper so each session folds origin/develop in often (minimal clash/conflicts)
body:
## Problem / why
Cross-session work drifts. The derived backlog stores auto-resolve on merge (BI-PF-1176 steps 1-2:
history=union, open/closed=pf-derived regenerate), but the two GENERATED docs
(docs/BACKLOG-SUMMARY.md, docs/documentation-index.html) and data/backlog/counters.json are NOT driver-covered,
so every late merge still conflicts on them. Worse, nothing folds origin/develop into a working branch often, so
a session drifts for hours and then faces one large merge with a wide conflict surface.

## Goal & value
Minimal clash/conflicts across concurrent sessions: (a) every shared/derived file auto-resolves on merge, and
(b) each worker folds origin/develop into their branch frequently (merge, never rebase/reset) so merges stay
small.

## In scope
- config/.gitattributes: attach merge=pf-derived to data/backlog/counters.json and the two generated docs.
- scripts/dev/pf_merge_driver.py: also (1) max-merge counters.json from the three merge inputs, and (2) regenerate
  the two generated docs from the backlog on merge.
- scripts/dev/sync_develop.py: fetch + merge origin/develop into the CURRENT branch; drivers auto-resolve the
  derived files; on any non-derived (source) conflict ABORT cleanly + list the files; modes --check and --pre-push.
- install_hooks.py: run the sync in the pre-push hook (per-worker self-service) so a push first folds develop in.
- AGENTS.md: note the per-worker sync step.

## Out of scope
- A background/scheduled job: git state is per working directory, so a folder-local job cannot span sessions and
  would race the editor (IS-PF-0036). Sync is per working tree, done by whoever is working.
- Auto-resolving SOURCE-file conflicts (those stay fail-closed/manual).

## Approach
Reuse the existing merge-driver mechanism (BI-PF-1176) and the existing hook installer (BI-PF-1249 precedent);
add the sync helper + wire it into pre-push. No new store, no new engine.

## Acceptance criteria
- A merge touching counters.json takes the max per key (no conflict).
- A merge touching the two generated docs regenerates them (no conflict).
- sync_develop.py merges develop into the branch; aborts cleanly + reports on a source conflict; --check reports
  behind/ahead without writing.
- pre-push runs the sync.
- Tests cover the counter max-merge + doc regeneration + the sync helper decision paths; precheck passes.

## Risks
- Counters max-merge could over-increment a label counter (harmless: labels only need to be unique/monotonic).
- Doc regeneration on merge depends on items/ being merged first (same assumption BI-PF-1176 already makes).

## Rollback
Revert the .gitattributes/driver/hook changes; merges fall back to manual resolution as today.

## Related
Extends BI-PF-1176 (steps 1-2); builds on BI-PF-1249 (pre-commit doc regen), BI-PF-0764 (remote id CAS).

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend scripts/dev/pf_merge_driver.py (add counters.json max-merge + regenerate both generated docs on merge), extend config/.gitattributes with merge=pf-derived for counters.json and the two docs, add scripts/dev/sync_develop.py (fetch+merge origin/develop, abort+report on source conflicts, --check/--pre-push modes), wire into scripts/dev/install_hooks.py pre-push (BI-PF-1249 pattern). Reuse BI-PF-1176 driver and BI-PF-1249 hook installer; no new engine or store.
dependency_findings: REQUIRES BI-PF-1176 steps 1-2 landed (driver infrastructure exists in working tree).
REQUIRES BI-PF-1249 hook installer pattern (install_hooks.py) for pre-push wiring.
RELATED BI-PF-0764 remote-id CAS informs fetch safety in sync_develop.
conflict_findings: BI-PF-1249/BI-PF-1232 touch the same doc generator and install_hooks.py — coordinate hook registration order.
BI-PF-1176 touched pf_merge_driver.py; if open in another session, serialize driver edits.
No API/component overlap with core/merge_gate.py (server-side PR gate, unrelated to git-local merge).
duplication_findings: BI-PF-1176 already established the merge=pf-derived driver for history/index; this extends it, not duplicates it.
BI-PF-1249 already regenerates docs in pre-commit; doc regen-on-merge is a new context for the same generator.
BI-PF-0258/BI-PF-1232 cover CI/pre-commit refresh of the same docs — keep generator calls shared to avoid drift.
analysis.rationale: Pure reuse-first extension of an existing merge driver + hook installer; fills the last un-driver-covered derived files and adds the missing frequent-sync helper. Low drift, bounded risk, clear rollback.
assumptions: Git per working tree; no cross-session job possible (IS-PF-0036 settled).
Merge-only policy (never rebase/reset) is already settled architecture.
counters.json is small enough for a deterministic per-key max merge.
origin/develop is the single integration branch.
risks: Counters max-merge can over-increment label counters (accept: uniqueness/monotonicity is what matters).
Doc regen on merge assumes items/ merged first (same assumption as BI-PF-1176).
Pre-push sync can surprise users by mutating their branch before push.
Source-conflict abort path must be rigorously tested to avoid half-merged state.
evidence: BI-PF-1176 steps 1-2 landed the union+regenerate driver precedent.
BI-PF-1249 precedent for hook-based self-service automation.
Item explicitly scopes out background jobs citing IS-PF-0036.
missing_info: Exact counters.json key schema (which keys are safe to max vs. must sum) — confirm with maintainer.
Pre-push sync default on/off vs opt-in flag for first rollout.
Whether --pre-push should auto-stash uncommitted work or hard-fail.
